method: Manual structured extraction by the design agent. Fuseini's Gemini-AI-Studio extraction route was attempted first: aistudio.google.com redirects to a signed-out Google account chooser in the browser profile, and no sign-in was performed (no crossing login walls).
reference_product: Verisart - certificates of authenticity for creative work (direct competitor reference)

typography.display: neo-grotesque sans, very large (64px+), italic emphasis, tight leading

composition.header: wordmark left, sparse centered nav, auth actions right
composition.hero: full-width rounded card, dark gradient, giant headline, single outlined CTA
composition.sections: two-column asymmetric grids, generous 80px+ vertical rhythm
composition.listings: thumbnail + italic title + meta rows, hairline dividers

adopted_for_humanmade: Uppercase letterspaced eyebrow labels above each section (already in build, confirmed by extraction)
One primary CTA per section; secondary actions as quiet outlines (confirmed)
Generous vertical rhythm and restrained section count
rejected_for_humanmade: Neo-grotesque sans identity - Human-made keeps its engraved serif notary identity to stay distinct from siblings
Dark gradient hero - off-identity for a paper certificate; ivory + vermillion seal retained
Left icon rail - unnecessary chrome for a single-purpose tool
